title: Moroccan Chickpea Stew (German Twist)
description: A hearty German-inspired stew infused with the exotic flavors of Morocco, featuring chickpeas and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add another tbsp of oil to the pot, then sauté the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and almond flour. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned pork, chickpeas, tomato paste, and 2 cups of water to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
